exactGap: Quarry has stateless compile_procedure, compare_replay, assess_quality and analyze_impact (browser_procedure.rs:61-200) behind four routes (agent_routes.rs:3685-3695); the compiled procedure is returned to the caller, version is hard-coded to 1 (browser_procedure.rs:108), nothing stores it, no execute route exists, and nothing outside Quarry calls these routes. compile_procedure rejects any receipt whose outcome is not Verified (browser_procedure.rs:85-96) while outcome_for_action marks click, type, press, scroll, select and evaluate as Unknown (observation.rs:217-262) and StepBody has no expect or postcondition field (agent_routes.rs:818-824), so a form-driving run cannot compile; ref-based actions also embed snapshot_id, generation and ref_id (contracts.rs:650-654) and compare_replay demands exact action equality, so a stored procedure could not replay in a new session without re-binding refs.
reuse: Quarry browser_procedure.rs compile, compare_replay, assess_quality and analyze_impact and the four existing routes: keep stateless and extend.
Durable non-ZDR step receipts (receipts.append at agent_routes.rs:2346-2391, list_for_actor) as the compile source.

Model Plane run-level postcondition: PlanConfig.postcondition and judge_browser_procedure (browser_agent.rs:262-285, postcondition.rs:996-1075) as the run-level verifier to pair with a new step-level expect evaluated by Quarry.
The normal step path /v1/agent/runs/:id/step with BrowserBroker grants, execution-core approval gate (browser_events.rs:238) and max_cost_usd budgets for any replay.
Existing SemanticLocator and ElementFingerprint (contracts.rs) as the stable locators to store instead of run-specific refs.
capability-core and session-core agent_skills registration path (skillsink/sink.go) and capability-core cron for scheduling replays.
constraints: Quarry's own code and docs put procedure rollout state and business approval outside Quarry: assess_quality 'supplies evidence for the owning release/Model workflow' (agent_routes.rs:2512-2527, browser_procedure.rs:150-152), Quarry 'does not silently replay or self-heal effectful procedures' (agent_routes.rs:2523-2527) and 'Model Plane remains the planner and policy owner' (agent_routes.rs:2462-2466); persistent rollout state is listed as future work (WEB_AGENT_ROADMAP_EXECUTION.md:93-96). A Quarry-owned store with an execute endpoint that replays steps would make Quarry the proposer, which breaks 'Model proposes, Quarry executes'. Every replay must re-run grants, sensitive-action approvals and budgets and must never reuse a stored approval; ZDR runs write no receipts (agent_routes.rs:2360-2391) so they can never be compiled or saved.
approachAdjustment: Keep Quarry's role as deterministic evidence: add an optional step-level expect assertion (URL pattern, ref present, text present) that Quarry evaluates after the action to upgrade the outcome to Verified, and canonicalise stored actions to stable locators (semantic locator or element fingerprint, stripping snapshot_id, generation and ref_id) so replay can re-bind against a fresh snapshot and fail closed on ambiguity. Put the procedure store (versioned, tagged, org and owner scoped, draft/promoted/quarantined) and the runner in Model Plane (capability-core registry or session-core), where the runner proposes each stored step to Quarry's normal step endpoint, uses Quarry's replay-check for comparison, and applies grants, approvals and budgets; 'save as procedure' and the list UI are Frontend work on top.
effortNote: Raised from L: step-level postconditions in Quarry, locator canonicalisation and replay re-binding, a Model Plane store plus runner with approvals and budgets, and UI. It also depends on the live planner loop, grants and budgets (F-t2-001, F-t2-008, F-t2-010). Could be staged: postconditions (M), canonicalisation (M), store plus runner (L).
verdictReason: The compile, replay-check, quality and impact functions exist and are wired to routes, so the item must say the stateless half is shipped; the missing half is a store, an execute path and postconditions. The proposed placement (Quarry store plus execute endpoint) conflicts with Quarry's documented design and the Model-proposes rule, and the item misses that ref-based actions are run-specific and cannot replay verbatim.

Gateway /api/ingestions/runs and /api/ingestions/evidence plus the Evidence panel as the place to attach a results table.

Quarry retention janitor in control (main.go:197-201, inert unless QUARRY_RETENTION_DAYS is set) for retention policy.
constraints: ZDR: /v1/crawl and /v1/batch are refused for ZDR callers (routes.rs:555-575), so a durable run result set never applies to ZDR; only synchronous scrape and extract can run under ZDR and those must stay stream-only. The result set must remain a working set with retention, not a second Data Plane (no retrieval or graph); Data Plane ingest stays an explicit decision. ACL: artifact reads are tenant (org) bound (resource_routes.rs:125-155), not per actor, so per-owner result visibility would be new work. Stored items can hold sensitive scraped content, so export must be streamed and audited.
approachAdjustment: Do not start with a new JSONL store plus Postgres index plus xlsx export. Smaller path: (1) add run_id to ArtifactSummary and a run filter on /v1/artifacts (S); (2) project per-page rows for crawl and batch from page_extracted events plus artifact refs, exposed as GET /v1/runs/{id}/items with csv and jsonl export streamed by the edge or gateway (M); (3) a table view in the Ingestions run detail with an ingest action. A durable structured result set only becomes meaningful once structured extraction runs as a durable job (today /v1/extract is synchronous and unpersisted), so tie the JSONL dataset design to that dependency rather than to existing runs.
effortNote: M for the projection-based approach; the item as originally designed (new JSONL store, Postgres index, retention policy, xlsx, table UI) is L.
verdictReason: The feature does not exist and the gap description is accurate, but the proposed storage design overbuilds when per-run artifact keys and page_extracted events already exist. Keep as a medium-priority item with the lighter projection approach and the durable-extract dependency stated.
